body.description: Find the founder or key decision maker at each company, get a verified email, and draft a personalized opener — ready to enroll in a sequence.
body.name: Founder & decision-maker outreach

columns.name: Seniority tier
columns.prompt:
ROLE: You classify job titles for sales routing.
CONTEXT: Contact: {contact_person}, title: {contact_title}, at {company}.
TASK: Classify the contact's seniority as exactly one of: C-LEVEL, VP, DIRECTOR, MANAGER, IC.
FORMAT: Output ONLY the tier word.
FALLBACK: If the title is missing or ambiguous, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

columns.name: Opening line
columns.prompt:
ROLE: You are an expert cold-email copywriter.
CONTEXT: Contact: {contact_person} ({contact_title}) at {company}. About the company: {description}.
TASK: Write ONE personalized opening line addressed to this person's role and company. No flattery, no 'I came across your company'.
FORMAT: One sentence, max 20 words, plain text.
FALLBACK: If you cannot reference anything specific, output INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

workbook.description: The contact waterfalls chain zero-key people-finders (site scrape, CrossLinked, StaffSpy roster). The output column enrolls finished rows in your sequencer once configured in Settings.
